notes: Two isnads for the saying meet at قتادة (the second introduced by «وقال لي خليفة»); the tail names Abu al-Aliya and the Companion
«يعني ابن عباس» is the compiler's gloss on «ابن عم، نبيكم» and is left out, as the gloss in «يعني ابن مهدي» is
Second saying «قال أنس وأبو بكرة عن النبي ... تحرس الملائكة» has its own short line of transmission; that is the ruling
